notes: Gilead paid $21B for Immunomedics' Trodelvy — an anti-TROP2 antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) for triple-negative breast cancer. FDA-approved Apr 2020 (accelerated, 3L+ TNBC); full approval Apr 2021. Deal closed Oct 2020. Subsequent label expansions into HR+/HER2- breast cancer, urothelial cancer. Peak sales estimate $3B reflects analyst consensus across approved + label-expansion indications. EV/peak ratio of 7.0× is on the high end for oncology ADCs, reflecting a strategic premium for Gilead's first ADC platform play.
selection_rationale: Recent (2020), single-asset, oncology-ADC M&A with a clear lead asset already approved at deal time. Anchors the post-de-risking end of the oncology-mAb/ADC cohort.
source: Gilead press release Sep 13 2020; Immunomedics SEC filings; FDA approval letter Apr 22 2020.
